name: Saren Arterius
reference_scope: First reference is a game render, cropped at torso. Second is the official full-body armor concept, reproduced in the official-art gallery. Lower-body details are concept-supported, not verified against a full-body final in-game model.
prompt: Create one neutral full-length character portrait of Saren Arterius, the fictional turian shown in these two official Mass Effect references. Use the first reference for his recognizable face and realistic gray armor materials, and the second for the whole costume. Preserve the asymmetry: the larger dark mechanical shoulder and arm are on his anatomical left; the narrower pale armored arm is on his anatomical right. Include the corrugated tubes and small blue lights as shown. Saren stands calmly, turned three quarters toward the right, with relaxed empty hands and both feet visible. Keep the complete head, spines, hands and toes inside the image, with generous transparent margins around the entire figure. One character and one view, soft even studio lighting, high-resolution realistic game-character illustration. No scenery, floor, shadow, captions, frame, equipment in the hands or visual effects. Transparent alpha background.
